name: A video from the idea
about: From an idea to an upload: research, a plan you approve, you record, then the edit, titles and thumbnails, a look at it in a feed, and the upload button.

topic.label: What is the video about?
topic.hint: The idea in a sentence or two. The agent reads it first and researches from it.

card.bring: An idea. The recordings come later, when the plan is approved.
card.you: Answer the agent, approve the plan, record, review the rough cut and the final, pick a title and thumbnail, press Upload.
card.agent: Researches the topic, writes the plan, edits the footage, checks it, then drafts titles and thumbnails.

start.hint: Next: press Go. The agent asks what the video is about.

withTopic.hint: Next: press Go. The agent reads your topic and asks only what it still needs.

stages.title: Brief
stages.focus: This is a whole video from the idea, and it can be a long video (16:9) or a YouTube Short (9:16, about 60 s). Ask what the video is about, who it is for, what the viewer should get from it, the length, and what they have already (notes, a script, footage). If the format is not clear from the idea, ask it. Before you end the stage, state the format: put the line `format: long` or `format: short` in .presence/format (one line, nothing else; the app reads it when the stage ends and lays the project out for it) and write the same format in brief.md, with the length (a Short is about 60 s, vertical 9:16 at 1080x1920).

stages.title: Research
stages.focus: Find what already wins for this topic on YouTube. If the user already searched from the Research page (studio/research/videos.json has videos), do not search again: write the notes. Otherwise run the research tool once with 3 to 5 viewer search phrases (skill research-titles), then study the outliers' thumbnails (skill research-thumbnails). Done when studio/research/videos.json has the videos with outlier scores and thumbnails, plus your notes and a thumbs brief.

stages.title: Plan
stages.focus: Write studio/plan.md (skill plan-video): the promise, three package ideas modelled on the research's outliers, the questions the package raises, the hook, the beats with what is said and shown, the ending, what to film. Keep any words the user already wrote there. A script, if the brief asks, goes in studio/script.md (skill script-video).

short.focus: Write studio/plan.md (skill plan-video) for a YouTube Short of about 60 seconds, vertical 9:16: the promise, the hook that lands in the first two seconds, three package ideas modelled on the research's outliers (Shorts titles are short; the first frame and the opening line are the thumbnail), the few beats with what is said and shown (each beat is seconds, not minutes), the ending, what to film (vertical, or framed so it can be reframed to 9:16). Keep any words the user already wrote there. A script, if the brief asks, goes in studio/script.md (skill script-video).

stages.title: Plan review
stages.focus: The user reads and edits the plan on the Studio's Plan page and approves it or sends it back with notes.

stages.title: Record
stages.focus: The user records from studio/plan.md (its What to film list) and drops the footage in.

stages.title: Rough cut
stages.focus: Make the rough cut from the footage, following studio/plan.md for the order of the beats: transcribe, scan, write video/out/edl.json with a cut_before on every cut, joins.py check and snap, build_rough.py, handover.py. Heavy steps run in the background.

short.focus: Make the 9:16 rough cut of a Short (about 60 s) from the footage, following studio/plan.md for the order of the beats: transcribe, scan, write video/out/edl.json at 1080x1920 (reframe the source with faces.py reframe, or a SPLIT of screen and cam) with a cut_before on every cut, joins.py check and snap, build_rough.py, handover.py. A Short is tight: the hook in the first two seconds, no dead air. Heavy steps run in the background.

stages.title: Rough review
stages.focus: The user watches the rough and goes through the Cuts list. Approve & lock fixes the talk.

stages.title: Visuals
stages.focus: Dress the locked rough: first write video/out/visual-plan.md (visuals-plan skill: each beat, what is on screen where, the one visual that helps), then events.json with the Events builder (times only from rough-words.json), run.py --proof, then run.py --final in the background. Never touch edl.json or rough.mp4.

short.focus: Dress the locked 9:16 rough: first write video/out/visual-plan.md (visuals-plan skill: each beat, what is on screen where, the one visual that helps), then events.json with Events.for_cut(cut, "short") (times only from rough-words.json): word captions in the Shorts style (shortcaps.py; captions are for Shorts only), the hook text, labels from the Shorts kit, punch-ins; every text inside the Shorts safe zone (y 120 or lower, x 60-900). run.py --proof, then run.py --final in the background. Never touch edl.json or rough.mp4.

stages.title: Inspect
stages.focus: check_cut.py, the contact sheet, no captions (a long video never has them), the plan's beats all there; each overlay against visual-plan.md: does it point at, explain, count or compare something real (any emoji, any lone text (not part of a callout, diagram, scoreboard or list), echo text or the same move repeated is a finding).

short.focus: check_cut.py (1080x1920, about 60 s), the contact sheet, the Shorts captions against the words, every text inside the Shorts safe zone, the hook in the first two seconds, the plan's beats all there; each overlay against visual-plan.md: does it point at, explain, count or compare something real (any emoji, any lone text (not part of a callout, diagram, scoreboard or list), echo text or the same move repeated is a finding).

stages.title: Final review
stages.focus: The user watches final.mp4. Sending it back goes to Visuals.

stages.title: Titles
stages.focus: Write 4 to 8 title options into studio/titles.json (skill title-options), modelled on the outliers in studio/research/videos.json and true to what the final cut shows. Keep the user's picks, notes, edits and own titles. Then draft studio/upload.json (skill upload-youtube): a description with chapters from the final cut's real times, tags, private visibility; never upload.

stages.title: Thumbnails
stages.focus: Make 2 to 4 thumbnail options (skill thumbnail-options): composed in code with server/studio/thumb_compose.py from frames of video/out/final.mp4, the user's own photos and big words; an AI background only from a model the user enabled. Never an AI face of the user, never AI text. Check each at phone size (--small). List them in studio/thumbs/options.json, each with the title it was made for.

stages.title: Feed
stages.focus: The user stars titles and thumbnails, compares the pairs on the Studio's Feed page between the real researched videos (light and dark, desktop and phone), picks one package, then approves.

stages.title: Upload
stages.focus: The user checks studio/upload.json on the Upload page and presses Upload. The agent never uploads.
